中文

体验优化
- 新增 `bootstrap <host>` 子命令:按 ssh 登录账号一键补齐远程环境(Node/dsh 装进该账号的 ~/.npm-global、~/.dsh、systemd linger、PATH 条目),幂等——实验室每人各自的账号在自己电脑上跑一次即可;`--upgrade` 同时解决"以后怎么更新远程 dsh"
- 远程 dsh 发现新增 `~/.npm-global/bin/dsh` 兜底探测,即使某个账号的 ssh 通道 PATH 不含 npm-global 也能正常识别与启动

问题修复
- `check` 改用探测到的绝对路径执行 node/dsh 版本检查(不再依赖 PATH 里有没有裸命令名),缺失提示与 `up`/`provision` 报错统一指向 `bootstrap`

其他变更
- `/remote` 斜杠命令新增 `bootstrap`;README 双语同步多账号使用流程(各自账号、各自会话、各自端口)

---

English

Improvements
- New `bootstrap <host>` subcommand installs the remote prerequisites for the account the ssh alias logs in as (Node, dsh into that account's ~/.npm-global, ~/.dsh, systemd linger, PATH entries) — idempotent, one run per labmate's own user; `--upgrade` also solves "how do I update remote dsh"
- Remote dsh discovery now falls back to probing `~/.npm-global/bin/dsh`, so accounts whose ssh-channel PATH omits the npm-global dir resolve dsh correctly

Bug Fixes
- `check` probes node/dsh via the discovered absolute paths instead of bare command names; missing-tool errors in `up`/`provision` and `check` hints now point at `bootstrap`

Chores
- `/remote` gains `bootstrap`; READMEs (EN/ZH) document the per-account multi-user flow
